descriptions.w3d_d28g_terrain_mesh_cells_80073290: Rebuilds a terrain chunk mesh: clears the per-material index counts, walks the inner 7x7x7 cells of a 9x9x9 grid, reads each cell's material from the run-length iterator at +28, and emits a quad of positions, uvs, colours, edge indices and list indices for each open cell edge, scaled by the frame time.
